name: flowluna
description: Lecteur audio haute fidélité native Windows avec égaliseur 10 bandes, cache hors-ligne et extraction yt-dlp/ffmpeg
author: vortexazur

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n "server,electron" -c "cyan,magenta" "cross-env PORT=3000 tsx server.ts" "wait-on http-get://localhost:3000 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:server && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run build:renderer && npm run dotnet:publish && powershell -Command "& 'C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Local\electron-builder\Cache\nsis-3.0.4.1\nsis-3.0.4.1-1mx3n\Bin\makensis.exe' installer.nsi"
scripts.dist:electron: npm run build && electron-builder build --win --config electron-builder.json5
scripts.dotnet:build: npm run build:renderer && dotnet build FlowLuna.Windows
scripts.dotnet:run: npm run build:renderer && dotnet run --project FlowLuna.Windows
scripts.dotnet:publish: dotnet publish FlowLuna.Windows -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o release-dotnet
